cards.card_text: Now land: a man consecrates a parcel of his land to the LORD, and it's valued by the seed it takes, fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.
cards.verse_text: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land, then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.
cards.snippet: …proportional to the seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.

cards.card_text: All that day and night and all the next day, nobody gathers less than ten homers, and they spread the quail out all around the camp.
cards.verse_text: No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.
cards.snippet: No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.

cards.card_text: A homer of seed will yield only an ephah of grain.
cards.verse_text: For ten acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.”
cards.snippet: …acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.”

cards.card_text: Hosea pays fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
cards.verse_text: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
cards.snippet: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
